event.title: Kylian Mbappé Faces Backlash in China Over Mao Zedong Comments
event.canonical_title: Kylian Mbappé Faces Backlash in China Over Mao Zedong Comments
event.summary: Kylian Mbappé is experiencing backlash in China following comments he made about Mao Zedong, referring to him as a 'dictator' during an interview. This controversy has led to at least two major Chinese brands reportedly severing ties with the football star. The incident has raised concerns about his popularity in the region.

timeline.title: Kylian Mbappé Faces Backlash in China Over Mao Zedong Comments
timeline.summary: Kylian Mbappé has faced significant backlash in China following a video in which he made comments about former Chinese leader Mao Zedong. As a result, two major Chinese brands have reportedly severed ties with the football superstar. In response to the outrage, Mbappé has issued an apology for his 'ill-judged' remarks.
key_facts: Kylian Mbappé made comments about Mao Zedong that sparked outrage in China.
Two major Chinese brands have dropped Mbappé following the incident.
Mbappé has apologized for his comments.
